about:
# Totem Bar for Gamepad

![Totem Bar for Gamepad logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/logo.png)

A shaman totem bar for World of Warcraft (WoW Forever client) that looks and
behaves like Blizzard's own, built for playing with a gamepad.

![Choosing an Earth totem with the gamepad in Totem Bar Focus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/4-selecting.jpg)

- **Totem bar.** Blizzard's look and art, with totem timers and the weapon
  enhancement. It can hide Blizzard's Totem Bar (on by default).
- **Totem Bar Focus.** Puts your gamepad on the totem bar: browse every
  totem with the D-pad and cast or assign with A/X.
- **Edit Mode.** Place the bar from Blizzard's Edit Mode.
- **Gamepad macros.** One-press "Bind to Action Bar" for the addon's macros,
  from the guide or the settings panel.
- **Sound alerts.** Totem expiring, totem gone and weapon enhancement expiring,
  using Blizzard's Cooldown Manager sounds or Text to Speech.
- **First-run guide and settings panel.** Both work fully with a gamepad.
- **Key bindings.** Totem slots, summon, recall and weapon enhancement, under
  Key Bindings → AddOns.

## A quick tour

**Set up in two steps.** The welcome guide adds Totem Bar Focus to a
gamepad button with one press of A.

![Welcome guide: add Totem Bar Focus, place the bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/1-welcome.jpg)
![Bind to Action Bar prompt for the TBG Focus macro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/2-bind.jpg)

**Your gamepad on the totem bar.** Totem Bar Focus moves along the bar with
the D-pad. Press A or X to cast. Open a slot to choose another totem.

![Totem Bar Focus on Strength of Earth Totem with its tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/3-focused.jpg)

**Timers and weapon enhancement.** See the time left on each totem. Choose
and cast your weapon enhancement from the same bar.

![Totem timers and the weapon enhancement choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/5-extras.jpg)

**Cast directly.** Bind one macro per element, and one for your weapon
enhancement. Each casts that slot's totem with one press.

![Gamepad Macros dialog with the Totem Bar Focus and cast macros](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/8-extra-macros.jpg)

**Place it in Edit Mode.** Move, scale and arrange the bar with Blizzard's
Edit Mode.

![The bar's settings in Blizzard's HUD Edit Mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/6-hud-edit-mode.jpg)

**Options your way.** Sound alerts, Totem Bar Focus behavior, gamepad
macros and key bindings, all in Options → AddOns.

![Options: general settings and sound alerts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/7-options.jpg)
![Options: Totem Bar Focus, gamepad macros and key bindings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/main/assets/screenshots/7-options-2.jpg)

## Development

Building, testing and releasing: see [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/jccr/TotemBarForGamepad/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md).

releases.name: Totem Bar for Gamepad 0.2.3
releases.notes:
### Fixed

- **Steam Deck and Steam Input showed numbered button glyphs** (1, 2, 3)
  instead of A, B, X, Y. Generic gamepads now get Blizzard's Xbox art.

### Changed

- **Button glyphs.** D-pad up and down, the shoulder buttons and the
  triggers now use Blizzard's button art, like the face buttons.

releases.name: Totem Bar for Gamepad 0.2.2
releases.notes:
### Fixed

- **Empty totem bar slots could show a totem** when the game's deprecated
  API fallbacks are off. The addon now uses the current action bar API.

releases.name: Totem Bar for Gamepad 0.2.1
releases.notes:
### Changed

- **Totem Expired alert is off by default** (None). Choose a sound for it
  in Options → AddOns.

releases.name: Totem Bar for Gamepad 0.2.0
releases.notes:
### New

- **Gamepad Macros dialog.** Every TBG macro in one place: Totem Bar Focus
  and the direct-cast macros for each element and the weapon enhancement.
  Press A to bind one to a gamepad button, or drag it to an action bar.
  Open it from Options → AddOns or the welcome guide. Opening it from
  Options closes Options, so LB + RB + D-pad paging works while binding.
- **Logo.** Shown next to the addon's name in the AddOns list.

### Changed

- **Welcome guide.** The D-pad moves through a 2×2 grid: the macro and
  Open Edit Mode, then Gamepad Macros and Open Options, then Done. The
  guide is more compact and opens higher on the screen.
- **Gamepad Macros dialog.** The bind and page-switching reminders are gone
  (the bind prompt explains them).
- **Default bar position.** Centered, with its bottom edge 5% of the
  screen's height above the bottom, on any screen size, UI scale, bar scale
  or orientation. Edit Mode's Reset Position returns the bar there.

### Fixed

- **Call of the Elements cast nothing** for elements the bar showed a
  totem for. The bar showed a default totem that was never put on the
  game's totem bar. It now shows the game's totem bar as it is: an empty
  slot shows as No Totem.
- **The Totem Expired sound played when recalling totems** with Totemic
  Recall.
- **Weapon enhancements showed Rank 1** in their tooltips and icons
  instead of the rank you've learned.
